text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin suffers an injury during<n>training, so I
bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, I'm fine. It's nothing<n>serious, so don't
worry.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
See, I'm all patched up now, so let's<n>get right back
to training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm sure! I can barely feel<n>the pain
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And I bet a bit of running will do<n>wonders for my
mood! I mean, I love<n>running! ♪
choice_data_list: I'm still worried, so please rest up.
As long as you don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're being dramatic. I'mstronger than I look, you know.
choice_data_list: But what if your injury worsens?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ngh. Don't give me that look...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, fine. I'll rest up for today. I<n>wouldn't want to
worry you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: A little disappointed, Ines Fujin<n>returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nice! I knew you'd say yes! Come<n>on, let's hit the
track!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of her light jog, Ines<n>Fujin's face
crumples up in pain.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. And after I acted all cool<n>back there. We
might have to call it a<n>day after all...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We cut our training session short, and<n>Ines Fujin
trudges back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Looks like I should be okay if<n>I keep the
exercises light.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I'm glad I powered through<n>training, even
with my injury.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While monitoring her injury, Ines<n>Fujin completes a
light training<n>session.
